subtitle: 國中程度引導式短文：回答三個問題，寫一次運動會的經驗
task: Write a short passage of 60–100 words about your school sports day. Your passage should answer these questions: (1) What did you or your class do to get ready for sports day? (2) What happened on that day? (3) How did you feel?
taskZh: 寫一篇 60–100 字的英文短文，寫一次學校運動會的經驗。短文要回答三個問題：(1) 你或你的班級怎麼準備運動會？(2) 運動會那天發生了什麼事？(3) 你有什麼感受？
focus: 內容：三個問題都要回答到
文法：過去發生的事用過去式，動詞變化正確
連接詞：用 and、but、so、because 讓句子連貫
拼字與標點：句首大寫、句尾加句點

en: Last month, our school had its sports day. Before that day, our class practiced the relay race after school every day. On sports day, the weather was sunny and hot. I was the third runner on our team. When I got the baton, I ran as fast as I could. Our class did not win first place, but we came in second. Everyone cheered and gave each other high fives. I was tired but very happy, because we worked hard together.
zh: 上個月，我們學校舉辦了運動會。運動會之前，我們班每天放學後都練習大隊接力。運動會那天，天氣晴朗又炎熱。我是我們隊的第三棒。拿到接力棒時，我用最快的速度往前跑。我們班沒有得到第一名，但拿到了第二名。大家歡呼著互相擊掌。我雖然很累，但非常開心，因為我們一起努力過。

patterns.zh: 在那天之前（交代準備過程）
patterns.example: Before that day, our class practiced the relay race after school every day.
When I got the baton, I ran as fast as I could.
Our class did not win first place, but we came in second.

patterns.zh: 說出感受，再用 because 說明原因
patterns.example: I was tired but very happy, because we worked hard together.

parts: Our class did not win first place.
combine.answer: Our class did not win first place, but we came in second.

parts: Everyone gave each other high fives.
combine.answer: Everyone cheered and gave each other high fives.
